basis: Organic aciduria umbrella; neurologic, cardiac and ocular damage vary by subtype, without an established group-wide frequency.

decisions.neurologic: none: neurologic damage is prominent in several subtypes, but involvement in at least 30% across this heterogeneous umbrella is not established.

basis: Cowden mucocutaneous/oral hamartomas define disease; benign thyroid lesions affect ~50-70% in Cowden disease. SDHB-specific estimates are limited; cancer risk alone excluded.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: intrinsic benign thyroid hamartomas/adenomas occur in ~50-70% of Cowden patients; this uses the parent phenotype, with limited SDHB-specific data.

basis: Facial skeletal overgrowth and strabismus/amblyopia define syndrome; dental open-bite malocclusion occurs in 30-79%. Cleft palate occurs in only 5-29%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: persistent dental open-bite malocclusion is a structural oral abnormality reported in 30-79%; occasional cleft palate is not the basis.

basis: Placental disease is outside the axes; the undefined syndrome's extra-placental findings have no frequencies or established diagnostic status.

decisions.neurologic: none: intracranial hemorrhage is reported without frequency or evidence that it defines this syndrome.
decisions.dermatologic: none: unspecified skin abnormalities lack evidence of defining or common direct skin damage.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: unspecified skeletal abnormalities lack frequency and diagnostic detail sufficient to establish this axis.

basis: Bone fragility defines OI IV; dentinogenesis imperfecta damages teeth in roughly half. Hearing loss is not reliably ≥30%; scleral coloration is non-damaging.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: dentinogenesis imperfecta affects roughly half and directly damages teeth; it is variable rather than required for the type IV bone-fragility diagnosis.

basis: Cleft palate, coloboma and deafness define syndrome; urethral hypospadias occurs in 80-99%. Radioulnar synostosis (30-79%) omitted at four-axis cap.

decisions.renal: involved: hypospadias is a urethral malformation, within the renal axis, reported in 80-99%; occasional ectopic kidney is not the basis.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: radioulnar synostosis qualifies at 30-79%, but is omitted under the four-axis cap in favor of more frequent urethral malformation.

basis: Defined by inflammation of a cardiac layer; an infectious, autoimmune or immune-mediated etiology is not established by inflammation alone.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: generic cardiac inflammation does not establish infection or an autoimmune/immune-mediated mechanism across this umbrella.

basis: Brain/digital malformations define disease; microphthalmia 80-99%, endocrine defects 30-79%. Cap omits GI, cardiac and urethral defects (30-79%); lobation alone lacks lung damage.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: anal atresia and oral clefts qualify at 30-79%, but are omitted under the cap, prioritizing very frequent eye defects and multigland endocrine malformations.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: adrenal/thyroid hypoplasia and hypothalamic-pituitary abnormalities occur in 30-79%; substantial endocrine malformations are retained under the cap.

basis: Photosensitive brittle-hair disease; neurodevelopmental impairment affects ~70-85%. Common damaging ocular disease or intrinsic immunodeficiency is not established.

decisions.neurologic: involved: developmental/intellectual impairment affects ~70-85%; it is a common associated manifestation rather than required to define photosensitive TTD1.

basis: Neurodevelopmental, skeletal and cardiac defects define the parent syndrome; hydronephrosis/reflux occur in 30-79%. Oral/dental abnormalities omitted at four-axis cap.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: congenital cardiac defects are part of the defining parent syndrome and a recognized major feature; HPO reports heart defects in 30-79%.
